cohort: Mothers delivering singletons between 37 and 42 weeks' gestation were included, while those with diabetes or hypertension were excluded.
finding: Maternal weight gain exceeding 16 kg during pregnancy was associated with a higher incidence of gestational hypertension, macrosomia, dystocia, and caesarean sections.
mod_finding: Caesarean sections were more common among women who gained >16 kg during pregnancy.
